prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. CACE N5 school vocabulary stimulus. ONE square image, one scene, pure white seamless background, only the named referents and indispensable support, no bystanders or unrelated objects. Entire composition centered in central 70 percent with broad white margin ALL sides; whole figures and objects, correct natural anatomy, friendly and suitable for primary school. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, symbols, watermark or collage. Make the exact spatial/possession/content relation visually unambiguous. Medium: synthetic photorealistic studio photograph, realistic clear glass and liquid. Exact target GOT + AMB + AIGUA. One ordinary transparent drinking glass, three quarters filled with clear still water. Clearly visible water surface and meniscus inside glass; water is colorless, glass base and rim distinct. Slight elevated three-quarter view. Only this glass and its water contents, no bottle, ice, straw, lemon, condensation decorations, person or extra props. Generous margins, soft neutral studio lighting.
